title: TransitLM: A Large-Scale Dataset and Benchmark for Map-Free Transit Route Generation
task: Transit route generation from origin-destination data
key_results: LLM trained on TransitLM generates structurally valid routes at high accuracy; implicitly grounds GPS coordinates to stations without explicit mapping
comments: Large-scale dataset (13M records) enables end-to-end map-free route planning, a practical contribution for urban mobility.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Transit route planning can be learned entirely from data without explicit map infrastructure

title: DelTA: Discriminative Token Credit Assignment for Reinforcement Learning from Verifiable Rewards
task: Token-level credit assignment in RL from verifiable rewards
key_results: DelTA improves Qwen3 by +3.26 points (8B) and +2.62 points (14B) on mathematical benchmarks over same-scale baselines
comments: Addresses the underexplored token-level interpretation of response-level rewards; discriminative reweighting is clever but limited to reward-based settings.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Centroid-based RLVR is dominated by high-frequency patterns, diluting discriminative directions

task: Proactive personal assistant agents for long-horizon user tasks

hypotheses.hypothesis: Agents can identify and act on hidden intents in multi-turn interactions
hypotheses.result: Confirmed but challenging—proactive assistance remains weak across models

title: Full Attention Strikes Back: Transferring Full Attention into Sparse within Hundred Training Steps
task: Efficient sparse attention for long-context LLM inference
key_results: RTPurbo achieves 9.36× prefill speedup at 1M context and 2.01× decode speedup while preserving near-lossless accuracy
comments: Minimal training overhead (hundreds of steps) via exploiting model's intrinsic sparsity; practical for production inference.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Full-attention LLMs are intrinsically sparse and can be sparsified with minimal training

hypotheses.hypothesis: Agent trajectories provide exploitable long-range dependency signals for direct supervision
